author: Ari Koslow
title: Graham Ike signs Exhibit 10 deal with Warriors
desc: Graham Ike agreed to an Exhibit 10 deal with the Warriors.
impact: Ike lands in a favorable spot with a Golden State team that can use more size. He was a double-double machine in college at Wyoming and Gonzaga.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tamin Lipsey signs Exhibit 10 deal with Pacers
desc: Iowa State's Tamin Lipsey has agreed to an Exhibit 10 deal with the Indiana Pacers.
impact: Lipsey had an impressive collegiate career at Iowa State. He will look to prove himself in the Summer League in July.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Coby White to sign a 3-year, $74 million deal with Hornets
desc: Coby White intends to sign a 3-year, $74 million deal to stay with the Charlotte Hornets.
impact: The status of the Hornets backcourt was up in the air with the trade of LaMelo Ball to Minnesota and the uncertainty of White's signing. Now that White has decided to stay, he should find himself in the starting lineup and the Hornets will have plenty of continuity to build off of as they look to become competitive in the East.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Quadir Copeland signs two-way contract with Rockets
desc: The Rockets signed Quadir Copeland to a two-way contract.
impact: Copeland began his collegiate career at Syracuse before transferring to McNeese and North Carolina State. He averaged 14 points on 49.4 percent shooting from the field with the Wolfpack. He'll look to prove himself in the Summer League.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Rafael Castro signs two-way contract with Bucks
desc: The Bucks signed Rafael Castro to a two-way contract.
impact: Castro just missed averaging a double-double in his final season in college after transferring to George Washington. He'll look to prove himself in the Summer League in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Peter Suder signs two-way contract with Lakers
desc: The Lakers signed Peter Suder to a two-way contract.
impact: Suder finished his collegiate career at Miami (OH) where he averaged 14 points on 54.6 percent shooting from the field. He'll look to prove himself in the Summer League in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lamar Wilkerson signs Exhibit 10 contract with Thunder
desc: The Thunder signed Lamar Wilkerson to an Exhibit 10 contract.
impact: Wilkerson averaged just under 21 points in his final collegiate season at Indiana. He spent his first three seasons in college at Sam Houston State. He'll look to prove himself in the Summer League.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Al Horford signs two-year contract with Warriors
desc: The Warriors signed Al Horford to a two-year, $14 million contract.
impact: Horford returns to Golden State after declining his player option. He is entering his 20th season in the NBA. He'll likely remain in his reserve role with the Warriors.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Josh Green traded to Minnesota Timberwolves
desc: Josh Green has been traded to the Minnesota Timberwolves as a part of a larger deal that sees LaMelo Ball go to Minnesota and Naz Reid and a host of picks return to Charlotte.
impact: Green isn't a game changing player but he is a nice depth option for when the team needs him. Don't expect him to get a ton of playing time, but he could find himself in some spot starts where he'd become fantasy relevant.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Naz Reid traded to Charlotte Hornets
desc: Naz Reid has been traded to the Charlotte Hornets along with a 2033 first round pick, three first round swaps, and three second round picks for LaMelo Ball and Josh Green.
impact: The Wolves needed a point guard and they now have their man. As for the Hornets, as a former Sixth Man of the Year, Naz is capable on offense though not prolific, and his defense can be suspect at times. However, he fills a need for the Hornets in giving them a good veteran option at the power forward spot as they look to get their youth up and running at guard and center.

author: Garrett Ball
title: LaMelo Ball traded to Minnesota Timberwolves
desc: LaMelo Ball has been traded to the Minnesota Timberwolves for Naz Reid, a 2033 first round pick, three first round pick swaps, and three second round picks. Charlotte is also sending Josh Green to Minnesota.
impact: This is a massive trade for the Hornets who are coming off of a promising year with their young core. Now that will need to be rebuilt, and LaMelo will look to give the Timberwolves a fierce backcourt duo alongside Anthony Edwards. He won't be the No.1 option for a team anymore, but Ant should open things up for LaMelo on offense.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tobe Awaka signs two-way deal with Bulls
desc: Undrafted Arizona forward Tobe Awaka has agreed to a two-way NBA deal with the Chicago Bulls.
impact: Awaka was one of the bigger surprises to go undrafted. He was one of the top offensive rebounders in college basketball at Arizona. He'll look to prove himself in Summer League action.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tre Donaldson signs two-way deal with Heat
desc: Undrafted Miami guard Tre Donaldson has agreed to a two-way NBA deal with the Miami Heat.
impact: Donaldson will get a chance to prove himself in the Summer League in July. He averaged a career-high 16 points per game in his lone season at Miami last year.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Isaiah Stewart traded to Memphis Grizzlies
desc: Isaiah Stewart is being traded to the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for three future second-round picks.
impact: It was revealed that Stewart was available for trade last week, and the big man is now heading to Memphis. The 25-year-old is coming off a season where he averaged 10 points and five rebounds a game while playing 22.7 minutes per night. He will give the Grizzlies a solid frontcourt depth piece.
